# Asset pipeline debate: Sol round 2

2026-10-24. Reviewed the [Opus report and probes at `38d4052c`](https://github.com/lakeczar/subnautica-clone/blob/38d4052caca25cdf3f09daa75ed7f2877b9f1c90/docs/build/research/ASSET-PIPELINE-OPUS.md), after committing [my independent report](ASSET-PIPELINE.md). Source/evidence inspection only; no new heavy runs.

**Opus is stronger on operational feasibility.** Its queued probes establish a working portable Blender and useful WSL CUDA/D3D12 paths; my report only proposed probing them. I missed Blender Lab's official MCP: its [background command](https://projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp/src/commit/dbbf836ad4b1025f14a2b3b504c43903f39e0b04/addon/blender_mcp_addon/cli.py) works without the community server's GUI timer dependency. The sketchbook/clean-build distinction and matched in-engine room comparison improve my recommendation. The timings remain indicative measurements of one tiny scene; the black UI capture remains unresolved.

Five corrections or missing contracts matter before implementation:

1. **Babylon defaults do not require forks (§3).** The [9.31 loader](https://unpkg.com/@babylonjs/loaders@9.31.0/glTF/2.0/glTFLoader.pure.js) does omit arbitrary attributes by default, but has extension hooks. [`skipMaterials`](https://unpkg.com/@babylonjs/loaders@9.31.0/glTF/glTFFileLoader.pure.js) avoids PBR creation; AssetContainer supports lifecycle ownership. Decoder URLs are [configurable](https://unpkg.com/@babylonjs/core@9.31.0/Meshes/Compression/meshoptCompression.js), and plain GLB does not request meshopt/Draco decoders merely because the loader exists. Opus acknowledges these are solvable, but “each is a fork” overstates the cost. I still prefer bake conversion: AssetContainer alone supplies neither residency accounting nor bounded uploads.

2. **The existing pack is not a generic asset format (§§3–4).** [Terrain codec v1](../../../src/render/biomes/terrainCodec.ts) rejects fractional cel classes such as −0.3/0.5 and quantises Y in 1/64 m steps, unsuitable for some small bevels. [Recipes](../../../src/render/kit/types.ts) have no hierarchy/socket contract; glTF nodes will not automatically become animated TransformNodes through this converter. AP-1/WK-1 must specify asset-local quantisation, class encoding and rigid-part bindings. Reuse the delivery system; explicitly version any format extension.

3. **Determinism is promising, not established (§5.3).** The [probe](https://github.com/lakeczar/subnautica-clone/blob/38d4052caca25cdf3f09daa75ed7f2877b9f1c90/docs/build/research/asset-pipeline-opus/probe/probe_bpy.py) always bakes AO on CPU and exports *before* selecting CUDA/OptiX for rendering. OptiX's render failed. Stored 4070 GLBs differ (`CYCLES`: SHA256 `eb172e2d…`; `EEVEE-background`: `e893871e…`): EEVEE skips AO. Thus “identical across engines” is false as written; GPU-bake reproducibility was not tested. One canister's position comparison also cannot establish identical complete packs. One-quantum differences cannot count as both noise and identical output. Require exact canonical-pack comparison, including colours, normals, classes, indices and collision; pin a canonical builder if cross-host rebuilds disagree.

4. **Accept the lease, strengthen its lifecycle (§5.2).** SCHED must enforce expiry/yield outside Blender, kill a stuck scope after the grace period, and confirm it is empty before releasing admission. Preserve the [existing remote receipt/no-duplicate rules](../WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMITS.md): SSH loss or exit 75/255 alone cannot authorise fallback while remote work might survive. Define request IDs/retry behaviour and distinguish an active long request from idle time. `any` jobs remain subject to factory-worker admission, including its exclusive runs; they do not necessarily start immediately. This is scheduler work, not an already-proved session feature.

5. **SSH improves exposure, not execution isolation (§§1.1, 5.2).** A cgroup limits resources; Python retains the sandbox user's file/network powers. Audit the actual mounts, credentials and network boundary. Say “no exposed Blender RPC listener”: the official fallback and optional viewer still use local sockets. The cited [community advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4h8q-hh2j-755w) affects versions **before 1.6.5**, so it does not establish that current 2.2.4 is vulnerable. Unauthenticated execution remains the relevant concern. Prefer an existing background driver or a small stdio driver; keep MCP optional.

**Revised recommendation:** adopt the probed 5.2.3 candidate and owner's queued alickers session now, with clean script rebuilds authoritative. Retain the hybrid, offline cel conversion, shared palette/kit, no paid tools or AI-generation dependency, and AP-1/WK-1 ownership split. I still disagree that a whole room is the smallest proof: first pass one reusable room module/prop through conversion, lighting, collision and eviction; then use ENV-1's room for the owner's tier decision. Keep evidence question-led, not an eight-image quota. Land the seam after WK-1 and the accepted CW-1 baseline, before wave B and atmosphere; optional MCP/viewer work must not delay it.
